name: Super Fine Knitters Limited
about: Super Fine Knitters Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of knitted fabrics and garments in India. The company offers pink knitted cotton velour, multi-color cotton, cord velour fabric, cotton velour double dye, polyester warp knit fabric, loop terry spun fabric, polyester micro mesh fabric, pique pc fabric, polyester fabric, printed polar fabric, yarn dyed fabric, printed polar fabric, yarn dyed auto striper, double sided terry fabric, micro interlock wicking, black and white stripe, auto stripe fabric, and cotton and pure lycra fabric. It also provides womens garments, including round neck t-shirt, outer wear, sports t-shirts, night suit and gown, plaid pyjamas, track suit, pullovers and sweaters, t-shirt, full zip hoody and jacket, hoody, icelandic coat, jacket, sweat shirt, and swing jacket. In addition, the company offers mens garments; and baby wear, kids tshirt, and kids bawa suit. Further, it provides job works; and yarn products. Super Fine Knitters Limited was founded in 1980 and is based in Ludhiana, India.
